article_notes: Diagnostic and histopathology report on 24 dogs with cerebral B. gibsoni babesiosis (smear, PCR of blood and CSF) among 136 smear-positive dogs at an Indian veterinary college; necropsy of 3 dogs. No marker or host/parasite factor is compared between dogs with and without cerebral babesiosis or between outcome groups; the results are descriptive (diagnostic findings and lesions). Nothing extractable against severity. Setting is a veterinary college teaching hospital (assumed referral).
